d:
Watch the soulful Srikanta Vishakanta Lyrical Video from the classic Kannada movie Anuraga Aralithu, featuring Dr. Rajkumar, Madhavi and Geetha.
This devotional-flavoured Kannada classic is sung by Dr. Rajkumar, with music composed by Upendrakumar and lyrics penned by Chi. Udayashanker. The film was directed by M. S. Rajashekar.
Directed by: M. S. Rajashekar
Produced by: M. S. Puttaswamy
Written by: Chi. Udayashankar
Artist Name: Dr. Rajkumar, Madhavi, Geetha
Music Director: Upendrakumar
Cinematography: V. K. Kannan
